content: This task was the CoNLL-2010 Shared Task (BIBREF0), which had 3 different subtasks. Task 1B was speculation cue detection on the BioScope Corpus, Task 1W was weasel identification from Wikipedia articles, and Task 2 was speculation scope resolution from the BioScope Corpus. For each task, the participants were provided the train and test set, which is henceforth referred to as Task 1B CoNLL and Task 2 CoNLL throughout this paper.
